name: vsa-spell
description: English spelling and real-word error checking with vector symbolic architectures, running in the browser without a language model.

scripts.data:build: python3 src/build_corpus.py && python3 src/make_testset.py && node src/make_confusions.mjs 320 && node src/make_commands.mjs
scripts.bench:baselines: node src/eval_js_baselines.mjs harper && node src/eval_js_baselines.mjs hunspell
scripts.train:context: node --max-old-space-size=14000 src/context3.mjs ext+big --export && node src/pack_models.mjs 4 && node src/make_gold.mjs
scripts.tune:decoder: node src/eval_decoder.mjs --tune 60 --n 1000 --harper && node src/eval_commands.mjs && node src/write_weights.mjs
